sections.title: Break-Out Vise
sections.sub: Portable, high-torque make-up and break-out for downhole tools. Three torque ratings. One compact footprint.

sections.title: Bring the break-out capability to the equipment
paras: The ProStar Mobile Break-Out Vise gives service companies and operators a portable, high-torque solution for breaking out and making up downhole tools without relying on a conventional shop-based bucking unit. Built for the realities of field operations, it brings the break-out capability to the equipment, not the equipment to the break-out machine.

The compact footprint and mobile support stand let the assembly set up in tight areas, in the field or in the shop. A sliding head moves the vise or the adjustable roller into position, so make-up and break-out happen inside the same footprint by shifting or rotating the tool. From make-up to break-out in minutes.
Available in three configurations: 40,000, 60,000 and 90,000 ft-lb. All three models are available to order now.

sections.sub: Verify casing ID. Confirm the program. Catch dimensional issues before the pipe goes downhole.

paras: Iron roughneck systems are the workhorses of modern rig floors. They make up and break out connections faster, safer, and more consistently than crews working tongs by hand. But like any piece of equipment, they drift. And when they drift, the connections they make up start drifting with them.

ProTorque’s iron roughneck torque testing service confirms that the equipment is making connections to spec. Independent verification, calibrated test fixtures, and documented results across the operating range.

Fiber-optic instrumented casing has become standard equipment for operators who need real-time monitoring of pressure, temperature, and acoustic events across the wellbore. Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and Distributed Temperature Sensing (DTS) systems deliver insights that conventional wireline interventions cannot. The data is only as good as the deployment.

Running casing with fiber-optic cable on the outside is not a standard casing job. The cable is fragile. The make-up has to protect it. The handling has to keep it intact from the rack to total depth.
